correctness.rationale: The quadratic secant integral gives the exact hull area as span cubed minus cubic gap sum. Conditional-uniform order statistics prove the independent Beta(n-1,2) range and Dirichlet normalized gaps. Factorial moments yield exact finite-n means and variances. Extreme order statistics give Gamma(2,1); exponential normalized spacings and a bivariate delta-method CLT yield Gaussian variance 360, jointly independent. Exact arithmetic (n=3..350) and independently reconstructed convex-hull areas match the formulas. Finite experiments are not used to prove the asymptotic limits.

value.rationale: The same n random-arc approximation exhibits a sharp design-dependent switch from leading order n^-1 non-Gaussian endpoint deficit to n^-2 mean deficit with n^-5/2 Gaussian interior fluctuations when endpoints are included. A complete exact distributional coupling and both finite-n variance formulas quantify this natural endpoint uncertainty in the standard parabolic local model of smooth convex boundaries, supporting random boundary approximation analysis beyond a routine single moment.
